name: Auto Parental Tags
description: Uses AI (Google Gemini, OpenAI, or LocalAI) to analyze movie and TV show metadata and automatically add audience target tags (kids, teens, adults). Considers target audience rather than just content ratings.
overview: Automatically tag movies and TV shows with target audience using AI
